## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle *jātaka* recounting the past life of the Buddha as the merchant-traveller Dàyì 大意 (\**Mahāmati* — distinct from the *Mahāmati* of the *Laṅkāvatāra*), narrated as a Buddha-discourse at Jetavana. Translated by [求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85) Guṇabhadra (394–468) in the Liú-Sòng. Signature: 「宋天竺三藏求那跋陀羅譯」. The Taishō header cross-references [T152(9)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0001) — [康僧會](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BA%B7%E5%83%A7%E6%9C%83) Kāng Sēnghuì's parallel narrative.

**Abstract**

T177 falls within Guṇabhadra's documented Liú-Sòng translation period at Jiànkāng (435–468 CE); the more specific bracket 435–443 corresponds to his earliest productive period at the Wǎguānsì 瓦官寺 before his move to the Xīnsì 新寺. The Indic source is uncertain; the narrative parallels the *Mahāmati-avadāna* tradition, but the precise Indic recension is unidentified.
